evidence_tiers.locked_audit: Pinned evaluation assumptions, metric definitions, and provenance summaries.
evidence_tiers.observed_immutable_source: TSTR, patched four-scenario evaluator, wrappers, and summary scripts.
evidence_tiers.safe_synthetic_probe: Dummy windows and labels used for pure helper behavior only.
evidence_tiers.checkpoint_schema_only: Generation input shape and checkpoint nesting only.
evidence_tiers.manuscript_variants: Publication and table claims preserved as provenance tiers.

split.held_out_test: one subject per fold, excluded from training and validation
split.standardization: fit on post-validation training windows only; apply unchanged to validation, held-out, and synthetic windows
split.ambiguity: Public/locked compatibility config records 0.20 while source safe subject split uses 0.15; preserve both evidence tiers.

scenarios.TRTR: real post-safe-split training data to held-out real test data
scenarios.Scarce: up to 2 real windows per class, sampled without replacement
scenarios.TSTR: synthetic-only training, configured 500 synthetic windows per class
scenarios.TSTR+Scarce: synthetic training plus scarce real windows

generation_input.sampler: Euler integration from t=1 to t=0
generation_input.actual_count_caveat: Cache metadata may reduce the configured count; do not infer count from configuration alone.

metrics.retention: per-fold scenario macro-F1 divided by per-fold TRTR macro-F1
metrics.fold_summary: mean and sample standard deviation across 12 folds

confusion_matrices.cm_count: number of folds with a nonzero cell, not number of samples

variants.3CH: separately trained accelerometer-only model; not inference-time channel dropping

window_grid.augmentation: 2 real plus up to 500 synthetic windows per class

vae_only_ablation.generation: per-class diagonal Gaussian in VAE latent space

blocked: final 6CH/3CH table because utility TeX is a header-only stub

prerequisites: keep results and caches outside Git

blockers: The VAE-safe 0.15 subject split and CNN 0.20 internal split must remain distinct.
3CH is a separate training policy but current preprocessing lineage is blocked.
Several published tables are partial/manual or lack final source artifacts.
Public release has no evaluator implementation and must not imply regenerated paper results.
uncertainties: Some table values were transferred or post-processed outside the direct summary path.
Cache metadata can override configured synthetic count.
Confusion matrix cm_count is fold presence count, not sample count.

verification_basis.pure_helper_probe: flatten_windows, stratified split, per-class caps, and sample-SD helper probes passed with dummy arrays.
verification_basis.source_distinction: TSTR.py and patched four-scenario evaluator were kept as separate provenance paths.
verification_basis.repositories: Audit and public repositories remained clean at their pinned commits.
verification_basis.artifacts: No result arrays, synthetic caches, checkpoints, or participant data were copied.
